svg.title: Variational quantum classifier on the Iris dataset
svg.desc: The 150 Iris flowers plotted by petal length and width, next to a 4-qubit variational circuit: ZFeatureMap encoding, RealAmplitudes ansatz, measurement. B.Sc. final project, compared with a classical SVM.
